decision: Retain existing enforced strict Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo. Deny reviewed services without verified cross-surface strict filtering or with opaque destination relays. Privacy branding alone is not a reason to block.

searxngSnapshot.selection: Every HTTPS instance, strip www only, retain exact host and all health states. No parent-domain expansion.
searxngSnapshot.refresh: Fetch directory, validate HTTPS hosts, union with prior reviewed domains in src/browserBypassDomains.ts, rebuild and run browser-bypass-policy plus iOS profile cap/reserve tests. Never drop prior denies or truncate a policy to fit.

boundaries: Finite inventory cannot identify every new, private or self-hosted web proxy. No claim of exhaustive Internet coverage.
Runtime enforcement is offline; directory failures cannot reopen blocked services.
Phone policy installation requires the existing supervised app-and-policy update transaction, and USB when the non-removable profile changes.
Other reviewed general search domains are denied conservatively because Vigil does not have verified strict filtering for them across supported surfaces; a cookie or query flag alone is insufficient.

deployment.sourceSync: Only six task files copied after tracked destinations matched workspace HEAD; unrelated existing edits retained.
deployment.macBlocker: Protected updater preflight rejected an unfinished earlier app replacement: /Applications/Vigil.app.vigil-next and /Applications/Vigil.app.vigil-transaction.json. Journal is rolling-back; global recovery manifest is absent. Recovery evidence retained; no manual app replacement or enforcement changes.
deployment.enforcement: No Vigil processes terminated and no watchdog or relaunch protection disabled.

inventory.scope: Search engines not integrated into Vigil strict enforcement, search anonymous views, remote browsers, translation/page-rendering relays. Existing proxy, Tor gateway and VPN site lists remain intact.
inventory.restrictionReason: Additional search services are denied because Vigil has no strict-filter transaction for them; this does not assert that each service lacks its own SafeSearch feature.

policyCapacity: Preserve the first supplemental mature-comics payload identity; split overflow into additional stable-UUID BuiltIn payloads of at most 500 entries. Do not truncate curated domains.

validation.overflow: 500 custom deny URLs exercise more than two actual BuiltIn payloads; every URL retained, distinct UUIDs, non-removable profile, AutoFilterEnabled=true, each DenyListURLs <=500.
validation.liveBrowserOrPhoneExecution: Not claimed; policy/guard tests run locally in isolated test data.
